whenToUse: Images whose details matter, such as maps, photos, or plans.
People move between the whole and parts on small screens.
Trackpad and Ctrl+wheel zoom are supported too.
whenNotToUse: Zooming the whole page (don't block browser zoom).
Body text (use the text size setting).
Small images with nothing more to see when zoomed.
accessibility: Zoom in, zoom out, and reset buttons make it usable without two fingers (WCAG 2.5.1).
Announce the zoom level with aria-live and include it in the image's name.
Don't block page zoom with things like user-scalable=no.
Put touch-action: none only on the image area.
